key.name: move-modifier
key.summary: Modifier that turns a drag into a workspace move

key.name: focused-tile-size
key.description: Grows the focused tile and shrinks the rest. 1 is the plain straight-edged drawing; 2 is the Klein model. From 1.8 up only the focused workspace's windows can be clicked.

key.name: page-keys-activate
key.summary: PgUp, PgDn and End activate the workspace like GNOME, instead of only moving focus
